# Third-party patches

`fastrom.ips`: [Magic Sword - Fastrom](https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/7627) by kandowontu. `build.py` applies it to the
clean ROM before assembling `src/`. All credit for it goes to its author. The music fix in `src/mfix2.asm` corrects a
timing problem that FastROM exposes in the game's sound driver handshake.
